name: mapcollector
description: A fun game to explore public transportation systems from around the world
author: Gustav Lindberg

scripts.build: npx tsc -p src && npx uglifyjs-folder app/app/src/main/assets/static/js -o app/app/src/main/assets/static/js -x .js -e
scripts.php-validate: python -c "import os; import subprocess; from pathlib import Path; [subprocess.run(['php', '-l', it]).returncode and exit(1) for it in Path('htdocs').rglob('*.php') if not it.parts[1] == 'vendor']"
